content.short: JiffyScan provides an explorer and data APIs for 4337-based transactions.
content.description: JiffyScan lets users explore transactions within the 4337 context (UserOp, Paymaster, and Bundler) without exposing the blockchain's complexities. It clarifies transaction details, surfaces failures, and makes it easy to share findings with stakeholders. Designed to streamline analysis of 4337 activity, the tool highlights where things go wrong and provides a clear view for teams and partners. MAUs rose eightfold from May 2023 to November 2023.
